question: What can be combined by an AMF?
gold_answer: concurrent 5GC-MT LR, 5GC-MO LR and 5GC-NI LR location requests
debate1_passage: An AMF may combine concurrent 5GC-MT LR, 5GC-MO LR and 5GC-NI LR location requests once any needed privacy related actions (e.g. UE notification and verification) have been performed for each 5GC-MT LR.

question: What may combine requests from the H GMLC?
debate1_answer: An H-GMLC may combine concurrent location requests for the same target User Equipment (UE) by executing only one request and using the resulting location estimate to satisfy other requests.
